name: synthetic-daily-withdrawal

reporting.context: Cedar Comets withdrew an earlier notice saying Tuesday training was cancelled. The club said the notice had been published in error. The correction did not provide a new assessment of player fitness.
reporting.headline: Cedar Comets retract a training notice

review: The fresh report is a correction to an erroneous notice; it does not establish recovery or a return to training.
Preserve the measured profile without treating cohort size 30 as a percentile or an improvement magnitude.
A concise measured reading may omit this report if it adds no supported playing characteristic.
